en.name: Mens Nostra
en.summary: On the Promotion of the Spiritual Exercises.
en.body: Pius XI commends the practice of making a retreat — the spiritual exercises in the Ignatian tradition — and asks that they be offered not only to clergy and religious but to lay people of every condition, including workers.

fr.name: Mens Nostra
fr.summary: Sur la promotion des exercices spirituels.
fr.body: Pie XI recommande la pratique de la retraite — les exercices spirituels de tradition ignatienne — et demande qu'ils soient proposés non seulement au clergé et aux religieux, mais aux laïcs de toute condition, ouvriers compris.
